description: Page-level JSON schema contract for technical textbook OCR and EN/ZH pocket output.

nodes.id: stable node id such as p0004-n001
nodes.type: heading | prose | math | figure | table | exercise | theorem | proof | footnote | bibliography
nodes.source_bbox: [x0, y0, x1, y1] in source-page coordinates when available
nodes.en: required for prose-like nodes; exact English source text
nodes.zh: required for prose-like nodes after translation; accurate modern Chinese
nodes.tex: required for math/table/theorem environments when editable TeX is available
nodes.locked: true for equations, diagrams, numeric tables, labels, and source references that must not be translated or paraphrased
nodes.asset: relative path for extracted figure/diagram/table image fallback
nodes.number: source numbering such as Equation (2.1), Figure 3.4, Proposition 1

review.reason: missing equation, table mismatch, uncertain OCR, figure-only fallback, etc.

rules: Copy math node TeX unchanged into every language edition.
Preserve table grid shape and numeric values exactly.
Keep figures and diagrams as assets unless they can be represented safely as native TeX/TikZ.
Do not generate final PDFs from pages with unresolved review.needed=true unless explicitly marked as a preview.
